_comment: Corrections to typing slips in the Kumbakonam (SARIT) text of the Bhagavadgītā, Bhīṣma Parva 25–42. Applied to data/normalized/mbh/vu.jsonl by etl/apply_errata.py (so the Mahābhārata and Gītā readers show the same text); etl/extract_gita.py then carries the 'corrected' list into the Gītā records. 'from' is the exact text of the SARIT-derived line; ' / ' in 'to' splits a line. Found by proofreading all 700 verses (Sonnet proofreaders, every entry checked by Claude Opus against the Pune text and the standard vulgate); genuine Kumbakonam readings are not changed. Reviewed by no human reader yet.
